initiatives.name: Really Really Free Market Tallahassee
initiatives.description: Free market in Tallahassee where people give away and take clothing, household items and other goods at no cost. Runs on Instagram as @rrfm.tally.

initiatives.name: Tallahassee Community Action Committee
initiatives.description: Tallahassee grassroots group that organizes direct action, events and meetings for peace, justice and equality.

initiatives.name: Tallahassee Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Food Not Bombs chapter that serves free vegan meals every Sunday 12-2 PM at E. Peck Greene Park in Tallahassee, plus hygiene supplies, clothing and bus passes.

initiatives.name: Tally Dissenters
initiatives.description: We are an anti-militarist & anti-imperialist youth-led organization turning the tides to divest from war & empire.
